analysis_scope: read-only BC rule fidelity and cost attribution; no new experiment

dataset_label_and_time_audit.formula: SEND_NOW iff first_emission is true and ready_step > 147; otherwise SKIP_EPISODE
dataset_label_and_time_audit.ready_step_source: recorded tape relay observation step minus exact integer float32 age_steps

source_path: R45 R3 selects OneShotSendSkipCollector and passes its policy through r42_run into the frozen v2_run episode runner
v2_run attaches the collector to the actual run.task_adapter.comm_relay and calls JointRun.run
JointRun.run delegates each step to JointSAROrchestrator.run, which yields JointSAROrchestrator.step
JointSAROrchestrator publishes detections before executor.step and advances clock afterward
InMemoryEventBus dispatches synchronously in subscription order
registry subscribes before CommRelay; CommRelay subscribes before the cycle's Task03Adapter step
CommRelay books a newly accepted event at old_tick+1; the same cycle relay tick increments before observation
older queued ready_step values remain <= current tick; the only non-event booking path sets ready_step=current tick
Task03Adapter is called through AssignmentGate.step; its relay tick precedes env.step
One-shot tape records int(observation.step), which is SendObservation.step=self._tick

raw_recomputation_git_vs_worktree.interpretation: The delivery commit adds this file; its parent has no path to compare. The committed LF JSON and checked-out worktree JSON are semantically identical. The worktree hash differs because it contains CRLF line endings. The earlier cited digest is not the current worktree or committed-blob digest and cannot be reconstructed from the parent.

teacher_time_basis.first_emission_ready_step_bound: event booking uses self._tick+1 before the next tick; observation increments the relay tick before exposing the candidate
teacher_time_basis.non_teacher_snapshot_fields: missing/not reconstructed; the policy is given only target_id, first_emission, ready_step
teacher_time_basis.reconstruction: ready_step = tape relay tick - exact integer float32(age_steps)

classification_evidence.assessment: The two extra first sends are local exact-vector support novelties relative to the frozen fit/validation dataset. This is consistent with local feature support shift, but does not establish broad distribution shift. No label/clock wiring, cutoff-boundary, missing-label, or exact-vector alias evidence explains them.

interpretation_limits: A model/teacher disagreement on the same saved 19D input is local imitation evidence, not a counterfactual policy result.
Exact-vector novelty is a narrow support diagnostic; it does not by itself establish broad distribution shift.
The analysis does not claim matched channel-RNG draws across policies or seeds.
A BC cost excess is not evidence PPO was ineffective; PPO did not run.
